sourceTitle: Confessions Of Con Cregan, the Irish Gil Blas
description: "Confessions of Con Cregan, the Irish Gil Blas" by Charles James Lever is a novel written in the mid-19th century. The story introduces a charming protagonist, Con Cregan, whose life begins in a humble cabin in Ireland, depicting his adventures as he navigates through the complexities of society, law, and fortune.
